# RNA Virome Atlas

> A visualization of the RVMT v1.4 catalogue: 378,253 RNA virus sequences assembled by
> Neri and colleagues from 5,150 globally distributed metatranscriptomes, about a
> five-fold expansion of the known RNA virosphere. Taxonomy, hosts, novelty, genome architecture
> and protein content, with every chart backed by a table of the same figures.

Site: https://curtishoffmann.com/rnaviromeatlas/
Maintainer: Curtis Hoffmann (https://curtishoffmann.com)
Source repository: https://github.com/phagehunter/rnaviromeatlas
Aggregated: 2026-10-24

## The data

- Catalogue: RVMT, release RiboV1.4, February 2022.
- Paper: Neri U, Wolf YI, Roux S, et al. Expansion of the global RNA virome reveals diverse clades of bacteriophages. Cell. 2022;185(21):4023-4037. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2022.08.023
- The aggregated counts this page draws are committed at data/data.json and produced by
  aggregate.py from three RVMT tables that are too large to commit. See README.md.

## Shape of the catalogue

- 378,253 sequences, 6 established phyla, 490 families,
  4,569 genera
- 348,762 sequences (92.2%) carry no match to a reference sequence
- 267 genera have no previously known member
- 2,121,723 protein-profile hits across the catalogue

### Sequences per phylum

- Lenarviricota: 119,074 sequences
- Pisuviricota: 118,672 sequences
- Kitrinoviricota: 74,817 sequences
- Unclassified: 50,001 sequences
- Duplornaviricota: 8,202 sequences
- Negarnaviricota: 7,292 sequences
- p.0002.base-Kitrino: 184 sequences
- p.0001.base-Kitrino: 11 sequences

### Study of record

- IMG/M - Chen et al 2019: 348,762 sequences
- Callanan et al 2020: 15,467 sequences
- RefSeq/GenBank: 9,705 sequences
- Wolf et al 2020: 4,294 sequences
- MATOU - Carradec, Q., Pelletier, E., Da Silva, C. et al 2018: 14 sequences
- Lauber et al 2019: 11 sequences

## Two figures readers get wrong

- The 4,569 genera are not all novel. Novelty is recorded per sequence, not per genus.
  267 genera have no previously known member; that is the "novel genera" number.
- The count of 5,150 metatranscriptomes comes from the paper. The released tables do
  not carry it, so this site cites it rather than computing it.
